metadata.description: One plugin, agentic-engineering, whose areas solve foundational engineering problems in the brave new world of agentic engineering.

plugins.name: agentic-engineering
plugins.description: A dozen plugins list about eighty skills, and a job does not say which one it needs, so this is one plugin: a person types /agentic-engineering:start-here and is asked what they want; an agent calls one of ten areas by name (agent-works, code, delivery, docs-parity, harness, perceptual-loop, picture-this, planning, system-map, writing); and each area routes to its own procedures, read as documents that cost nothing until one is taken.
